facts.fact: in background mode: a first bake_all writes 20 files; bake_all on an already-baked domain returns FINISHED without baking again; free_all returns at once while has_cache_baked_data still reads True and the files are still on disk (19 or 20 of them in two runs), and both had settled (False, 0 files) after a frame_set; a bake_all then bakes all 20 again; pointing a baked domain at a new cache_directory and calling bake_all writes only 2 files there
